person_note: The controlling narration is third-person limited, shifting focal attention among Charlie, Molly, and Ignatius without changing grammatical person. The authorized opening establishes sustained third-person narration around Charlie, and interior structural evidence shows the same external narration across other focal characters. q10490 independently displays that pattern. First- and second-person forms elsewhere are dialogue, maxims, attributed thought, clipped local material, or—in q10480's case—a quote from another Baldacci novel; none establishes an autonomous first- or second-person narrative section. No credible evidence of person alternation was found.
